title: Economy Watchers Survey Provides Datasets and Tasks for Japanese Financial Domain

live_model.evidence: Sec 3.1: "We test the representative LLMs, ChatGPT (gpt-3.5-turbo-0125) and GPT-4o (gpt-4o-2024-05-13)"; Table 4: "GPT-4o (5) 63.1 38.3 39.9" (macro F1 across three tasks)

prompt.note: Zero-/5-shot settings are labeled "(0)"/"(5)" in Table 4, but no prompt text or template is shown anywhere; the paper has no Appendix.

claim.location: Table 4, row GPT-4o (5); full task test sets run tens of thousands of items (Table 3), but the LLM-evaluation subsample size is not stated

data.source: Economy Watchers Survey datasets, auto-updated monthly on GitHub and Hugging Face Hub

notes: Dataset release is exemplary (monthly auto-updated via GitHub Actions to Hugging Face), but the exact prompt given to GPT-4o is never printed, and the sample size actually sent to the API (vs. the full BERT-scale train/dev/test splits) is not stated.
